pulse: NQ weekend tape still leans on Friday's -2.9% Nasdaq rout, but Iran FM Araghchi told Al Jazeera the US Vance message was a 'positive step' and mediators' nuclear proposals are under review, with Iran's team in Doha; offset is Tehran's hard conditions (sanctions relief, fewer US forces, its own Hormuz route) and no direct US meeting planned.
bias: mixed — constructive Doha/Vance-letter headlines lift de-escalation odds into Sun 6 PM ET open, but Iran's Hormuz-on-our-terms demands, Friday's tanker mine hits and post-Nov 3 strike plans keep CL risk and NQ pressure alive.
items: @DeItaone (~9:10 AM ET): Araghchi to Al Jazeera: Tehran studied Vance message, US effort to open broader dialogue a 'positive step'; mediators' nuclear proposals under review — Bullish NQ

@FirstSquawk (~9:17 AM ET): Iran conditions include lifting post-Islamabad MOU sanctions, cutting US forces in region, recognizing its Oman-agreed Hormuz route and closing others; Hormuz reopening on Tehran's terms would pave way for talks — Bearish NQ (oil)
@FirstSquawk (~9:03 AM ET): Araghchi: no plans to meet US officials for now; Iran delegation in Doha with Qatari mediators, who consult US negotiators throughout (~8:26 AM ET) — Mixed NQ
X News (~6:46 AM ET): 4 tankers hit naval mines Fri in Hormuz after ignoring IRGC route warnings, supertanker left burning — Bearish NQ (CL bid)
@FirstSquawk (~9:03 AM ET): FT: crypto exchanges tighten security after $6.3B Binance heist — Mixed NQ (COIN/crypto beta)
trump: No new Trump posts this morning; X News (~9:19 AM ET) says he claimed Venezuela oil gains covered Iran war costs 'many, many times' over (Pentagon puts war cost ~$47.1B), keeping war spending in focus before Nov 3.

reports.pulse: NQ sits on Friday's -2.9% Nasdaq rout (AI capex/FCF fears, NVDA -4%) with a weekend Iran escalation tone as Khamenei orders a target list of 'all US and Israeli assets' after a US Navy strike on boats near Qeshm; offset is Qatar-brokered US-Iran talks moving to Doha and oversold-bounce odds into Sunday's open.
reports.bias: risk-off — Iranian escalation rhetoric, Hormuz incident and post-midterm strike plans keep CL bid and pressure NQ after a correction week; Doha talks are the only real offset before Sun 6 PM ET futures open.
items: @FirstSquawk (~6:41 AM ET): Khamenei orders armed forces to update target list to bring 'all US and Israeli assets' within range, orders 'geographically unrestricted response' to any threat — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~5:39 AM ET): Tasnim says US Navy attacked Iranian fishing boats near Qeshm (Hormuz); Saudi civil defense alerts in Najran/Jizan overnight — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~2:32 AM ET): Qatari mediators held 12+ hrs of talks in Tehran to revive US-Iran negotiations; X News (~7:00 AM ET) says Iranian team headed to Doha, possible US delegation — Bullish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~7:02 AM ET): Russia extends diesel export ban through January; Ukraine hits Ufa refinery — Bearish NQ (energy/inflation)
X News (~9:06 PM ET Fri): NVDA -4% to $204.64 Fri on AI spending worries, testing 200-day ~$204; NVDA earnings Nov 17 — Bearish NQ
